title: Nvidia Working With Outside Firm to Identify CEO Candidates
snippet: Nvidia Corp.’s board has been working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman who is reportedly suspected of spying for China, a person familiar with the situation said.

title: Nvidia Board Meets on Huang’s Fate After Affair With Alleged Spy
snippet: Nvidia Corp.’s board is meeting to discuss the fate of Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, who admitted to having an affair with a woman that US officials reportedly believe to be a Chinese spy, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

title: Hosin, Amicro Set to Trade in Hong Kong as IPOs Gather Pace
snippet: Chinese memory product maker Hosin Electronics Co. and robotics technology platform Amicro Technology Co. are set to begin trading on Thursday in Hong Kong in a test of investor appetite for technology stocks in the region ahead of Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster US listing.
